recommendations.title: Buy Cleveland Cavaliers to win
recommendations.matchup: New York Knicks at Cleveland Cavaliers
recommendations.reason: Recommendation: buy Cleveland Cavaliers on the moneyline at home. Stripping the book's vig puts their fair win probability around 44%, and after adjusting for our home-court signal and historical bucket performance we estimate 46%. At +120 that is roughly +1.5% expected value per dollar, which is the threshold this model requires before flagging a side.
